name: zsnd_sample_init_from_wave_data_a3d
description: zSndSample::InitFromWaveData_A3D creates and fills an A3D backend buffer from parsed wave data.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred: current source matches behavior and reaches byte alignment through the post-Rewind spatial provider calls, but VC byte comparison still differs in the marker allocation and marker-loop tail.
